blockers: The intended theatrical broken-diagonal personality is not legible in the canonical idle or locomotion sheets; most poses remain front-facing, upright, and symmetrically arranged.
The signature gesture does not clearly communicate gambling, cards, or coins at native 192x192 scale. It reads as a generic arm wave with tiny white hand details.
The materials are rendered with broad airbrushed gradients and specular blobs that collapse into soft green and magenta masses at sprite scale, undermining the required retro readability.
The face is an oversized pale blank oval with minimal features. At native scale it lacks enough structure to establish character and risks reading as a generic mannequin.
The static silhouette has a strong hat-and-coat outline, but the broad triangular duster and compact legs produce a generic dress-like body mass rather than a clearly theatrical gambler silhouette.
high_value_changes: Redesign the idle around an asymmetrical weight shift: one hip dropped, torso counter-tilted, hat angle and coat hem offset, with the arm positions forming a deliberate broken diagonal rather than mirrored elbows.
Make the signature prop unmistakable: enlarge and separate a fan of cards or a coin arc into a few high-contrast pixel shapes, with readable anticipation, flourish, overshoot, and settle phases.

Replace smooth gradients with stepped value bands and controlled highlight clusters. Keep emerald, crimson, and violet separated by darker contour/shadow pixels so coat, vest, and accessories do not merge.
Add a small number of high-impact facial pixels for nose, eyes, mouth, and cheek or shadow structure. Preserve clarity at 1x instead of relying on a large smooth face plane.

Introduce clearer coat-tail, sleeve, hand, and hat-ribbon motion arcs in locomotion. The current eight-direction grid changes facing and foot placement more than it expresses a distinct slippery gait.
Verify every frame at native scale against a neutral light and dark background; the white gloves, shoes, and face currently overtake the intended prop and costume hierarchy.
optional_notes: The 124.4px standing height and approximately 1px anchor drift satisfy the stated technical limits, but the near-limit height leaves little room for future hat or prop exaggeration.
The hat is the strongest recognition cue: brim, tilt, and violet ribbon survive the silhouette test, although the ribbon is too fine to function reliably as a color cue at native scale.

Compared with Celina, the Gambler does not strongly converge in palette or narrow body type. Both do share a vertically posed humanoid presentation with bent arms, so stronger lateral asymmetry and a more distinctive lower-body rhythm are still needed.

The gesture strip appears to contain movement, but the small thumbnails do not demonstrate a convincing anticipation-to-release-to-settle arc. The action needs a readable focal event, not merely hand displacement.
The locomotion feet generally preserve the ground relationship, but several views feel like alternating leg swaps under a stationary coat rather than weight transferring through the pelvis and torso.
regressions_from_previous: Relative to the stated intended archetype, the current round appears to regress toward a static front-facing mannequin: the promised broken diagonals and slippery jaunty rhythm are not visible in the canonical presentation.
The prop identity is weaker than the costume identity; the cards or coins are not visibly more explicit in the signature gesture than in the base pose.
The retro-anachronistic pixel language remains compromised by smooth 3D-style shading and specular gradients, creating a readability regression even where the palette itself is distinctive.
strongest_improvements: The tilted fedora and violet ribbon provide immediate upper-body recognition.
The emerald duster versus crimson vest creates a useful primary color hierarchy when viewed against the dark background.
The silhouette mask cleanly separates the hat, bent arms, coat flare, gloves, and narrow legs.
Technical dimensions and anchor placement are within contract, and the directional grid is complete.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the signature gesture and canonical idle as a genuinely asymmetrical card-or-coin flourish: establish a planted hip and counter-lean, exaggerate the hat and coat diagonals, and make the prop readable as a few bold native-scale pixel shapes through anticipation, release, overshoot, and settle.
